abilities.name: run-away
abilities.effect: Ensures success fleeing from wild battles.

abilities.name: pickup
abilities.effect: Picks up other Pokémon's used and Flung held items.  May also pick up an item after battle.

abilities.name: skill-link
abilities.effect: Extends two-to-five-hit moves and triple kick to their full length every time.

original-johto.flavorText: It uses its tail to hang on to tree branches. It uses its momentum to swing from one branch to another.

hoenn.flavorText: Its tail ends with a dexterous, handlike appendage. However, because it uses the tail so much, AIPOM’s real hands have become rather clumsy.

original-sinnoh.flavorText: It lives atop giant trees. It wraps its tail around a branch so it won’t fall off while asleep.

extended-sinnoh.flavorText: It lives high among the treetops. It can use its tail as freely and cleverly as its hands.

updated-johto.flavorText: It lives atop tall trees. When leaping from branch to branch, it deftly uses its tail for balance.

original-unova.flavorText: It lives high among the treetops. It can use its tail as freely and cleverly as its hands.

updated-unova.flavorText: It lives high among the treetops. It can use its tail as freely and cleverly as its hands.

kalos.flavorText: Its tail is so powerful that it can use it to grab a tree branch and hold itself up in the air.

updated-hoenn.flavorText: Aipom’s tail ends in a hand-like appendage that can be cleverly manipulated. However, because the Pokémon uses its tail so much, its real hands have become rather clumsy.

updated-alola.flavorText: It searches for prey from the tops of trees. When it spots its favorite food, Bounsweet, Aipom gets excited and pounces.
